CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.esports_development_action(p_action text, p_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_expected integer DEFAULT 0, p_payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin perform private.esports_write_limit();return private.esports_development_action_internal(p_action,p_id,p_expected,p_payload);end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.esports_write_limit()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 begin
 if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Authentication required';end if;
 perform 1 from public.profiles where id=auth.uid() for update;
 if (select count(*) from private.esports_audit where actor_id=auth.uid() and created_at>now()-interval '1 minute')>=120 then raise exception 'Esports write rate limit';end if;
 end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.esports_submit(p_cycle uuid, p_payload jsonb, p_ticket uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 begin
 delete from private.captcha_tickets where id=p_ticket and user_id=auth.uid() and cycle_id=p_cycle and expires_at>now();
 if not found then raise exception 'CAPTCHA required';end if;
 return private.esports_submit_internal(p_cycle,p_payload);
 end;$function$
